race.description: Racing Mates Bbq At Hawkesbury Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: MAYLEIGH (4) has progressed nicely this prep. Ran on stoutly to collect his maiden win two back over this distance at Kembla. Held that performance level but found one a bit better over the mile last start. Gets all the favours from the inside alley and will be hard to hold out when produced. ALABAMA CHARM (8) has really hit her straps this prep. Has won two of her last three with a solid third over this distance at Taree in between. Only needs to hold this form to be right in contention again. PIPERITA (3) has not landed a blow in five appearances this prep. Drops in grade today and the stable tinker with her gear. Twice a winner at this trip - no surprise if she ran a much better race this afternoon. OURAGAN (7) has been in the money at her last three, most recently over the mile here where she loomed to win but found one better. Races well at Hawkesbury and coming back to 1400m shouldn't bother her. Lightly raced mare EMERALD HILLS (2) is in the mix off a 29-week lay-off.
